repos.readme:
# AQUASCAPE — Public Projects & Ecosystem Portal [![Deploy to GitHub Pages](https://github.com/aquascapedotorg/landing_aquascape/actions/workflows/update-repos.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/aquascapedotorg/landing_aquascape/actions/workflows/update-repos.yml) [![Live Site](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live-aquascapedotorg.github.io-38bdb0.svg?style=flat&logo=github)](https://aquascapedotorg.github.io/landing_aquascape/) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-61dafb.svg?logo=react)](https://react.dev/) [![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-8-646cff.svg?logo=vite)](https://vitejs.dev/) [![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind-v4-38bdf8.svg?logo=tailwindcss)](https://tailwindcss.com/) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5-3178c6.svg?logo=typescript)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)

Portal katalog dan dokumentasi resmi untuk organisasi GitHub aquascapedotorg.
Menyajikan ringkasan proyek dan dokumentasi tingkat tinggi secara terpusat, terotomasi, dan aman.

--- ## Tujuan Proyek Organisasi GitHub **AQUASCAPE** mengelola repositori publik (open-source) dan internal (privat). Landing page ini dibangun untuk memenuhi kebutuhan berikut: 1. **Visibilitas Proyek Tanpa Mengekspos Kode Sumber (Privacy-Preserving Showcase)** - Memberikan akses publik kepada mitra, klien, dan komunitas untuk melihat katalog proyek aktif yang sedang dikerjakan organisasi. - Menyediakan sarana membaca dokumentasi resmi (`README.md`) dari setiap proyek langsung di web tanpa harus membuka akses ke repositori privat atau membocorkan implementasi kode internal. 2. **Sinkronisasi Otomatis Tanpa Intervensi Manual (Automated Data Pipeline)** - Memanfaatkan GitHub Actions terjadwal (cron) dan pemicu push. - Mengambil metadata dan isi README repositori organisasi secara berkala menggunakan Fine-grained Personal Access Token, lalu mem-build dan men-deploy ulang situs ke GitHub Pages secara otomatis. 3. **Identitas Visual Ekosistem Aquascape** - Mengintegrasikan kanvas simulasi akuarium interaktif berbasis Web Canvas API dan Web Audio API untuk merefleksikan identitas organisasi. --- ## Fitur - **Simulasi Kanvas Aquascape (60 FPS)** - Simulasi pergerakan ikan maskot origami dengan algoritma kemudi (*steering behavior*). - Tanaman air (*Vallisneria* dan *Rotala*) dengan deformasi dinamis mengikuti arus air. - Partikel gelembung CO2 dan riak permukaan air. - Interaksi pengguna: klik pada kanvas untuk menjatuhkan pakan ikan (*food feeding*). - **Kontrol Pencahayaan & Audio Ambient** - Tiga profil pencahayaan akuarium: *Daylight*, *Sunset*, dan *Night*. - Generator audio ambient sintesis berbasis Web Audio API (efek air dan gelembung tanpa file audio eksternal). - Mode Zen: tampilan akuarium layar penuh tanpa elemen antarmuka lain. - **Katalog & Navigasi Proyek** - Pencarian instan berbasis teks untuk nama, deskripsi, dan topik/tags repositori. - Filter interaktif berdasarkan bahasa pemrograman (TypeScript, Python, HTML, CSS, dsb.). - Indikator status visibilitas (*Public* / *Private*). - **In-App Markdown Reader** - Modal pembaca dokumen `README.md` terintegrasi menggunakan parser *GitHub Flavored Markdown* (GFM). - Tampilan metadata: tanggal pembaruan terakhir, link ke repositori GitHub, dan navigasi keyboard (`Esc`). - **Ikan Komunal dari Supabase (Realtime)** - Sumber data ikan dapat dialihkan antara file lokal (`public/fish-names.json`) dan Supabase melalui variabel `.env` (`VITE_FISH_DATA_SOURCE`). - Dalam mode Supabase, kanvas menampilkan semua ikan yang dikirim hari ini (plus satu maskot) dan menerima ikan baru secara **realtime tanpa refresh** (WebSocket + polling fallback). - Ikan baru ditambahkan lewat webhook (POST langsung ke tabel Supabase). Lihat [`docs/WEBHOOK.md`](docs/WEBHOOK.md) untuk endpoint, daftar spesies, dan format respons. - **Streak, Kuaci & Papan Peringkat** - Streak kehadiran per peserta dihitung dari riwayat kehadiran; **weekend & hari libur nasional** ([`public/holidays.txt`](public/holidays.txt)) menjembatani streak tanpa memutus. - Akumulasi kuaci harian per ikan dan snapshot streak disimpan di Supabase. - Panel papan peringkat (Zen mode) menampilkan ikon spesies tiap peserta; klik/hover sebuah baris menyorot ikannya di kanvas. --- ## Arsitektur & Alur Kerja ```mermaid flowchart LR A[GitHub Org: aquascapedotorg] -->|Cron & Push Trigger| B[GitHub Actions Runner] B -->|node generate-data.js| C[GitHub REST API] C -->|Metadata & Raw README| B B -->|Simpan Cache| D[(repos.json)] D -->|Vite Build| E[Distributable Bundle /dist] E -->|Deploy| F[GitHub Pages] ``` ### Rincian Alur Kerja: 1. Workflow GitHub Actions ([`.github/workflows/update-repos.yml`](.github/workflows/update-repos.yml)) dijalankan secara berkala atau setiap ada commit di branch `main`. 2. Script [`generate-data.js`](generate-data.js) menggunakan secret `ORG_TOKEN` untuk melakukan autentikasi ke GitHub API: - Mengambil daftar seluruh repositori dalam organisasi `aquascapedotorg`. - Mengambil metadata (nama, deskripsi, topik, bahasa utama, timestamp). - Mengambil isi `README.md` (di-decode dari Base64). 3. Data disimpan ke `repos.json` dan disalin ke `public/repos.json`. 4. Jika terdapat perubahan data repositori, GitHub Actions bot membuat commit pembaruan data secara otomatis. 5. Vite mem-build aplikasi React ke direktori `./dist`. 6. Artefak `./dist` di-deploy ke GitHub Pages. --- ## Menjalankan Secara Lokal ### Prasyarat - **Node.js**: versi 20.x atau 22.x+ - **NPM** atau **Bun** ### Langkah Instalasi & Menjalankan 1. Clone repositori: ```bash git clone https://github.com/aquascapedotorg/landing_aquascape.git cd landing_aquascape ``` 2. Pasang dependensi: ```bash npm install --legacy-peer-deps # atau menggunakan Bun: bun install ``` 3. Jalankan server pengembangan lokal: ```bash npm run dev # atau menggunakan Bun: bun run dev ``` Aplikasi dapat diakses melalui `http://localhost:3000/`. 4. Generate data repositori secara lokal (opsional, memerlukan token GitHub): ```bash GITHUB_TOKEN=your_token_here node generate-data.js ``` 5. Build untuk produksi: ```bash npm run build # atau menggunakan Bun: bun run build ``` --- ## Konfigurasi GitHub Actions & Secret Token Agar workflow otomatis dapat membaca repositori organisasi (termasuk yang berstatus privat), buat Fine-grained Personal Access Token di GitHub: 1. Buka **GitHub Settings > Developer Settings > Personal Access Tokens > Fine-grained tokens**. 2. Klik **Generate new token**. 3. Konfigurasi token: - **Resource owner**: `aquascapedotorg` - **Repository access**: *All repositories* - **Repository permissions**: - `Contents`: Read-only (untuk membaca file `README.md`) - `Metadata`: Read-only (untuk membaca metadata repositori) 4. Buka repositori **landing_aquascape** di GitHub. 5. Masuk ke **Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions**. 6. Tambahkan secret baru dengan nama `ORG_TOKEN` dan masukkan nilai token yang telah dibuat. --- ## Konfigurasi Supabase (Opsional) Fitur ikan komunal, streak, dan papan peringkat memakai Supabase. Jika tidak diaktifkan, aplikasi memakai nama ikan lokal dari `public/fish-names.json`. 1. Salin `.env.example` menjadi `.env` dan isi kredensial: ```env VITE_FISH_DATA_SOURCE=supabase VITE_SUPABASE_URL=https://.supabase.co VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= VITE_SUPABASE_FISH_TABLE=communal_fishes ``` Variabel `VITE_*` juga perlu diset sebagai **environment variable** pada workflow build (GitHub Pages) agar ter-*bake* ke bundle. 2. Jalankan skrip SQL di **Supabase Dashboard → SQL Editor** (sekali saja, aman dijalankan ulang): - [`supabase/schema.sql`](supabase/schema.sql) — tabel `communal_fishes` + RLS + Realtime. - [`supabase/streak.sql`](supabase/streak.sql) — tabel `fish_daily_kuaci` & `fish_streaks` + RPC. 3. Keamanan: `anon key` memang publik; yang melindungi data adalah **RLS**. Policy dibatasi ke *read* publik + *insert* tervalidasi (nama 1–100 karakter, `entry_date` = hari ini); penulisan kuaci/streak hanya lewat RPC `SECURITY DEFINER`. Detail webhook & respons di [`docs/WEBHOOK.md`](docs/WEBHOOK.md). --- ## Struktur Direktori ```text landing_aquascape/ ├── .github/ │ └── workflows/ │ └── update-repos.yml # Workflow CI/CD sinkronisasi data & deploy Pages ├── public/ │ ├── static/ # Asset grafis resmi yang disalin saat build │ ├── logo.svg # Maskot SVG │ ├── fish-names.json # Katalog spesies & nama ikan lokal (fallback) │ ├── holidays.txt # Daftar hari libur nasional (skip streak) │ ├── zen-config.json # Preset & default konfigurasi Zen mode │ └── repos.json # Salinan data repositori publik ├── src/ │ ├── components/ │ │ ├── AquascapeAudio.ts # Web Audio API ambient sound generator │ │ ├── AquascapeCanvas.tsx # Simulasi kanvas akuarium interaktif 60 FPS │ │ ├── AquascapeControls.tsx # Panel kontrol pencahayaan & interaksi │ │ ├── AquascapeLogo.tsx # Komponen logo & banner resmi AQUASCAPE │ │ ├── FishCustomizerModal.tsx # Modal atur jenis/kepadatan ikan (mode lokal) │ │ ├── FishSpeciesIcon.tsx # Ikon SVG kepala ikan per spesies │ │ ├── Header.tsx # Navigasi atas, kontrol audio & mode zen │ │ ├── Hero.tsx # Section hero dengan banner & living tank │ │ ├── ProjectCard.tsx # Komponen kartu proyek & tag repositori │ │ ├── ReadmeModal.tsx # Modal pembaca Markdown dokumentasi │ │ ├── StreakLeaderboardDrawer.tsx # Panel papan peringkat streak (Zen) │ │ ├── ZenAquariumModal.tsx # Tampilan akuarium layar penuh + telemetry │ │ ├── aquascapeEvents.ts # Event bus kanvas (spawn, highlight, dsb.) │ │ ├── fishRenderer.ts # Fungsi gambar ikan & nametag di kanvas │ │ └── lifeCycleHelper.ts # Logika siklus hidup & rasa lapar ikan │ ├── data/ │ │ ├── fishCatalog.ts # Loader katalog ikan (lokal/Supabase) │ │ ├── reposData.ts # Data cadangan (fallback) awal repositori │ │ └── zenConfig.ts # Loader konfigurasi Zen mode │ ├── services/ │ │ ├── supabaseFishService.ts # Fetch/realtime ikan komunal + mode source │ │ ├── streakCalculations.ts # Perhitungan streak & papan peringkat (murni) │ │ └── streakService.ts # Orkestrasi streak: fetch, buffer, snapshot │ ├── App.tsx # Komponen utama & state management │ ├── main.tsx # Entrypoint React DOM │ ├── index.css # Konfigurasi Tailwind CSS v4 & custom style │ └── types.ts # Definisi tipe TypeScript ├── supabase/ │ ├── schema.sql # Skema tabel communal_fishes + RLS + Realtime │ ├── streak.sql # Tabel kuaci & streak + RPC SECURITY DEFINER │ └── cleanup-names.sql # Utilitas merapikan nama (spasi/typo) ├── docs/ │ └── WEBHOOK.md # Dokumentasi webhook penambahan ikan ├── static/ # File master grafis resmi (logo transparan, banner) ├── generate-data.js # Script ekstraksi metadata & README via GitHub API ├── repos.json # Cache data repositori lokal ├── vite.config.ts # Konfigurasi Vite & path relatif ├── tsconfig.json # Konfigurasi TypeScript compiler └── package.json # Konfigurasi dependensi dan script npm ``` --- ## Lisensi & Hak Cipta Hak Cipta (c) 2026 **AQUASCAPE** (`aquascapedotorg`). Seluruh hak cipta dilindungi undang-undang.

repos.name: kindle
repos.readme:
# Kindle

**Kindle** adalah codename internal untuk **FIF Pulse**, platform gamifikasi dan engagement untuk tim sales lapangan.

Namanya berarti "menyalakan": menyalakan lagi semangat sales yang lesu dan menjaga yang sudah jalan tetap menyala.

- **Aplikasi sales (Android):** pekerjaan sehari-hari (booking, kunjungan dealer, calon nasabah, kuis produk) tampil sebagai misi dengan hadiah Koin dan Poin.
- **Web manajemen:** kantor membagi sales ke kategori Lesu, On-Track, dan Top, membuat misi Generic atau Spesifik, lalu memantau hasilnya.
- **Data:** berdiri sendiri dan hanya menerima data masuk, dari file yang diunggah tim bisnis setiap hari. Tidak ada integrasi ke sistem klien.

## Mulai dari sini

Baca **[`docs/What_Next.md`](docs/What_Next.md)** dulu. Isinya daftar pekerjaan tim yang diambil dari MoM meeting eksternal (16/10) dan internal (20/10): siapa mengerjakan apa, tenggatnya, dan apa yang sudah ada di repo ini.

Arah tim saat ini:
1. **Sampai Kamis 22/10:** lengkapi skenario end-to-end (sisi sales dan Game Master), mockup satu skenario lengkap, daftar tipe misi, dan dua opsi validasi.
2. **Jumat 23/10, 16.00:** review internal semua materi.
3. **Setelah review:** estimasi effort dan budget, NDA, lalu FGD dengan FIF.

Kalau ada pekerjaan selesai, ubah kolom "Posisi sekarang" di `What_Next.md`, supaya semua tim melihat status yang sama.

## Struktur folder

| Folder | Isi |
|---|---|
| `storyboard/` | Export storyboard. Buka `index.html` di browser. Edit per papan di `storyboard/papan/`. File asli canvas ada di `storyboard/sumber-canvas/`. |
| `prototype/` | Prototype HTML: versi internal (lengkap) dan versi client (tanpa angka rupiah). Buka langsung di browser. |
| `docs/` | Katalog gamifikasi (`Katalog_Gamifikasi_FIF_Pulse.md`) dan spreadsheet persiapan FGD. |
| `docs/MoM/` | Notulen meeting internal dan eksternal. |
| `docs/flowchart/` | Flowchart As-Is dan To-Be. |
| `docs/What_Next.md` | Daftar pekerjaan tim dari kedua MoM. |

## Catatan

- Nama, cabang, dan angka di storyboard dan prototype hanya contoh.
- Repo ini berisi informasi klien. Simpan sebagai repo **private**.

repos.name: nawala
repos.readme:
# Nawala (e-Office AI): Workflow, Desain Low-fi, dan Video

Landasan pembangunan e-Office AI: sistem surat-menyurat yang membaca, memahami, dan menyiapkan pekerjaan surat. Prinsipnya: **AI menyiapkan, manusia memutuskan.** AI tidak pernah mengirim disposisi atau surat tanpa klik dari orang.

| File | Isi |
|---|---|
| `docs/BRD_Nawala_v0.1.md` | Business Requirements Document (draft) |
| `docs/PROTOTYPE_RULES.md` | Aturan untuk model yang membangun prototype: no AI slop untuk tampilan, stop-slop untuk teks UI |
| `workflow-eoffice-ai.png` | Swimlane alur surat masuk sampai surat balasan |
| `lowfi/L01..L09-*.png` | 9 layar low-fi |
| `eoffice-ai-workflow.mp4` | Video penjelasan 78 detik, 1920x1080 |
| `video/` | Source Remotion. Layar low-fi dan video memakai komponen yang sama |

Konvensi warna di semua layar: **ungu = dikerjakan AI**, abu-abu dan hitam = dikerjakan orang.

## Peran

| Peran | Tugas |
|---|---|
| Agendaris (TU) | Menerima surat, memeriksa hasil baca AI, mencatat agenda, menerbitkan surat keluar |
| Pimpinan | Membaca ringkasan, memutuskan disposisi, menyetujui surat keluar, memantau |
| Pelaksana | Menindaklanjuti disposisi, menyunting dan mengajukan draft balasan |
| AI e-Office | Membaca surat, meringkas, mengecek surat mirip, menyarankan disposisi, mengingatkan tenggat, menyusun draft |

Admin (struktur organisasi, aturan routing, template surat) tidak muncul di alur harian, tetapi datanya wajib ada sebelum go-live.

## Alur

| No | Peran | Langkah | Layar |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Agendaris | Surat diterima (kertas, email, WhatsApp, scanner), difoto atau diunggah | L01 Surat Masuk |
| 2 | AI | OCR, mengisi nomor, tanggal, pengirim, perihal, sifat, jenis, tenggat. Meringkas 3 poin. Mengecek surat mirip | L02 Catat Surat |
| 3 | Agendaris | **Keputusan: surat mirip?** Ya: tautkan ke surat lama, selesai. Tidak: periksa field "Perlu dicek", catat, nomor agenda terbit | L02 Catat Surat |
| 4 | AI | Saran disposisi. Aturan routing organisasi dicek dulu, baru tebakan AI. Selalu disertai alasan | L03 Detail Surat |
| 5 | Pimpinan | Membaca ringkasan, menerima atau mengganti saran, memilih instruksi dan batas waktu, mengirim | L03, L04 Form Disposisi |
| 6 | Pelaksana | Menerima notifikasi, status Baru, Dibaca, Dikerjakan tercatat otomatis. Bisa meneruskan ke bawahan atau mengembalikan | L05 Disposisi Saya |
| 7 | Pelaksana | **Keputusan: perlu balasan?** Tidak: tandai selesai dengan catatan hasil. Ya: lanjut | L05 |
| 8 | AI | Pengingat 2 hari sebelum tenggat, draft balasan dari template kantor | L06 Draft Balasan |
| 9 | Pelaksana | Menyunting draft, mengajukan persetujuan | L06 |
| 10 | Pimpinan | **Keputusan: setuju?** Tidak: kembali ke Pelaksana untuk revisi. Ya: tandatangani | L07 Surat Keluar |
| 11 | Agendaris | Menerbitkan surat keluar dengan nomor otomatis, mengirim. Surat masuk otomatis berstatus Dibalas | L07 |

Kapan saja: **L08 Pantau Disposisi** (Pimpinan) dan **L09 Cari** dengan kalimat biasa (semua peran). Tinjauan risiko kontrak muncul sebagai tab di L03 bila jenis surat adalah kontrak.

## Status

- Surat masuk: Perlu dicatat, Tercatat, Didisposisi, Dikerjakan, Dibalas, Selesai, Lewat tenggat
- Disposisi: Baru, Dibaca, Dikerjakan, Selesai, Dikembalikan
- Surat keluar: Draft, Menunggu persetujuan, Revisi, Disetujui, Terbit, Terkirim

## Yang Perlu Diputuskan Sebelum Membangun

1. Kebijakan data AI: boleh model cloud, atau wajib model lokal (untuk klien bank dan BUMN)
2. Tanda tangan di langkah 10: tanda tangan internal, atau tanda tangan elektronik tersertifikasi (PSrE)
3. Format nomor agenda dan nomor surat keluar milik klien
4. Siapa yang mengisi aturan routing dan struktur organisasi awal

## Mengubah dan Merender Ulang

Data dan teks layar ada di `video/src/screens.tsx`, alur di `video/src/workflow.tsx`, adegan video di `video/src/Walkthrough.tsx`.

```bash
cd video
npx remotion studio
```

```bash
npx remotion render Walkthrough ../eoffice-ai-workflow.mp4
```

```bash
npx remotion still L02-CatatSurat ../lowfi/L02-CatatSurat.png
```

repos.name: archiva
repos.readme:
# Archiva

Archiva is a multi-tenant SaaS document management system (DMS). It gives an organization one place to upload documents, have AI suggest a category, tags and metadata, search across titles, metadata and file content, and control access, audit and retention per category.

## Contents

- [Status](#status)
- [Tech stack](#tech-stack)
- [Prerequisites](#prerequisites)
- [Quickstart](#quickstart)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Common commands](#common-commands)
- [Repository structure](#repository-structure)
- [Architecture notes](#architecture-notes)
- [Further documentation](#further-documentation)

## Status

Phase 1 (core web DMS) is in development. The target architecture includes OpenSearch, S3-compatible storage and a BullMQ worker; these are provisioned in `docker-compose.yml` but not yet used by the application. See [Architecture notes](#architecture-notes) for what is live today.

## Tech stack

| Layer | Technology |
| --- | --- |
| Monorepo | Bun workspaces (`apps/*`, `packages/*`) |
| API | Bun, Hono, TypeScript (`apps/api`) |
| Web | React 19, Vite, TypeScript (`apps/web`) |
| Worker | Bun (`apps/worker`), currently a stub |
| Database | PostgreSQL 16 with row-level security, via Drizzle ORM |
| Shared code | Zod schemas in `packages/shared`, used by API and web |
| AI | Google Gemini (`@google/genai`) for document categorization |

## Prerequisites

- [Bun](https://bun.com) 1.3 or later
- Docker with Docker Compose
- A Google AI API key, if you want AI categorization (optional, see [Configuration](#configuration))

## Quickstart

1. Install dependencies:

   ```bash
   bun install
   ```

2. Start PostgreSQL. It is the only service the application needs today:

   ```bash
   docker-compose up -d postgres
   ```

   `docker-compose up -d` also starts Redis, OpenSearch and MinIO.

3. Create `apps/api/.env`. To run without AI categorization:

   ```dotenv
   AI_CATEGORIZATION_ENABLED=false
   ```

   To enable it, set `GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY` instead. All other variables have local defaults.

4. Create the schema and seed a demo tenant:

   ```bash
   bun run --cwd apps/api db:push
   bun run --cwd apps/api src/db/seed.ts
   ```

   The seed is safe to rerun; it skips rows that already exist.

5. Start the API, worker and web app:

   ```bash
   bun run dev
   ```

   - Web: http://localhost:5173
   - API: http://localhost:8787

6. Sign in with a seeded account:

   | Role | Email | Password |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | Super Admin | `admin@archiva.com` | `admin123` |
   | Member Team | `member@archiva.com` | `member123` |

   These credentials are for local development only.

## Configuration

The API reads these variables from the environment or `apps/api/.env`:

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `postgresql://archiva:archiva_password@127.0.0.1:5436/archiva` | PostgreSQL connection (matches `docker-compose.yml`) |
| `JWT_SECRET` | `archiva_secret` | JWT signing secret. Set a strong value outside local development. |
| `PORT` | `8787` | API port |
| `STORAGE_DIR` | `<cwd>/storage` | Directory for uploaded files |
| `AI_CATEGORIZATION_ENABLED` | enabled | Set to `false` to skip Gemini calls on upload |
| `GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY` | none | Gemini API key, required when AI categorization is enabled |

The web app calls the API at `http://localhost:8787` (`apps/web/src/api/client.ts`).

Never commit `.env` files or the `storage/` directory; both are listed in `.gitignore`.

## Common commands

| Task | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Run everything | `bun run dev` |
| Run one app | `bun run dev:api`, `bun run dev:worker`, `bun run dev:web` |
| Build the web app | `bun run build:web` |
| Lint the web app | `bun run --cwd apps/web lint` |
| Generate a migration | `bun run --cwd apps/api db:generate` |
| Apply the schema | `bun run --cwd apps/api db:push` |
| Run tests | `bun test` (no test files exist yet) |

The root `bun run lint` currently fails because only `apps/web` defines a `lint` script.

### PM2 (optional)

`ecosystem.config.cjs` defines long-running dev processes: `archiva-api-8787`, `archiva-worker` and `archiva-web-5173`. It points at a Windows Bun install path; adjust `interpreter` for your machine.

```bash
pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
pm2 status
pm2 logs
```

## Repository structure

```
archiva/
├── apps/
│   ├── api/                Hono API
│   │   ├── drizzle/        Generated SQL migrations
│   │   ├── src/db/         Schema, connection (withTenant), seed
│   │   ├── src/middleware/ Auth middleware
│   │   ├── src/routes/     auth, tenants, parameters, documents, search,
│   │   │                   audit, permissions, retention, categories
│   │   └── src/services/   Storage and other services
│   ├── web/                React + Vite frontend
│   └── worker/             Background worker (stub)
├── packages/
│   └── shared/             Zod schemas shared by api and web
├── docs/                   PRD, user stories, tech and system design
├── scripts/                Helper scripts (xlsx to Markdown)
├── docker-compose.yml      Postgres, Redis, OpenSearch, MinIO
└── ecosystem.config.cjs    PM2 process definitions
```

All API routes are mounted under `/api` (for example `/api/auth`, `/api/documents`).

## Architecture notes

- **Tenant isolation.** PostgreSQL is the source of truth. Every tenant-scoped table has a `tenant_isolation` RLS policy keyed on `current_setting('app.tenant_id')`. `withTenant()` in `apps/api/src/db/index.ts` sets that context per request.
- **Search** is a PostgreSQL `ILIKE` query (`apps/api/src/routes/search.ts`), not OpenSearch.
- **File storage** is the local filesystem under `STORAGE_DIR/{tenantId}/{hash prefix}/` (`apps/api/src/services/storage.ts`), not S3 or MinIO.
- **Worker** does not process jobs yet; Redis and BullMQ are not wired in.

## Further documentation

Product and design documents (in Indonesian) live in [`docs/`](docs/):

- [PRD-Archiva.md](docs/PRD-Archiva.md): product requirements, roles and phasing
- [User-Stories-and-AC.md](docs/User-Stories-and-AC.md): user stories and acceptance criteria
- [User-Flow-Archiva.md](docs/User-Flow-Archiva.md): user flows and state machine
- [2026-08-03-Archiva-Tech-Design.md](docs/2026-08-03-Archiva-Tech-Design.md): technical design (DDL, endpoints, modules)
- [2026-08-04-Archiva-System-Design.md](docs/2026-08-04-Archiva-System-Design.md): capacity, caching, queues, failover
- [design.md](docs/design.md): UI design reference

repos.readme:
# Deployment Checklist (turtwig-ddcl)

Internal maker-checker app that gates UAT and Production deployments with evidence-based checklists, independent review, hotfix retros, and an auditable ledger.

## What and why

Teams deploy across many client projects with different pipelines, skipped steps, and no reliable record of what went out, when, and by whom. This app standardises the process around a deployment without forcing one pipeline:

1. A **maker** fills the project's checklist for UAT or Production with evidence (links, files, notes).
2. An independent **checker** verifies each item and approves before deployment.
3. The maker deploys, then records the real outcome: success, failed, or rolled back.
4. Urgent **hotfixes** deploy first and get a retro review by 17:00 the next working day.
5. Every action lands in an immutable **ledger** the EM and Heads filter across projects.

Terms are defined in [docs/GLOSSARY.md](docs/GLOSSARY.md).

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
| --- | --- |
| Backend | Go 1.26 modular monolith, chi, REST + OpenAPI 3.1, sqlc + pgx, goose migrations, River jobs |
| Frontend | React 19, TypeScript strict, Vite 6, TanStack Router and Query, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui; embedded in the Go binary |
| Data | PostgreSQL 17, Garage (S3-compatible) for evidence files |
| Notifications | In-app, email (SMTP), Telegram bot |
| Delivery | One distroless image on GHCR, Docker Compose per host, Caddy for TLS |

Details: [docs/technical-specs/04-tech-stack.md](docs/technical-specs/04-tech-stack.md).

## Quickstart

> The application code arrives with the Sprint 0 scaffold (cards BE-S0-01 to BE-S0-09, FE-S0-01 to FE-S0-04). Until then the repository holds documentation and CI only. The commands below are the contract those cards implement.

Prerequisites: Go 1.26, Node 22, pnpm 9, Docker with Compose v2, GNU make.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aquascapedotorg/turtwig-ddcl.git && cd turtwig-ddcl
cp .env.example .env                # local defaults; APP_ENV=local
make dev-up                         # postgres 17, garage, mailpit via deploy/compose.local.yml
make migrate                        # embedded goose + River migrations
make seed SET=dev                   # sample projects, users, requests
make run                            # API + embedded SPA on http://localhost:8080
make web-dev                        # optional: Vite dev server with hot reload on http://localhost:5173
make test                           # Go (testcontainers) and web tests
```

Local services: app `:8080`, Vite `:5173`, Mailpit UI `http://localhost:8025`, S3 API `http://localhost:9000` (Garage has no console), Postgres `:5432`. Seed logins are in `e2e/fixtures/users.ts`.

## Repository map

```text
turtwig-ddcl/
├── api/openapi.yaml       # REST contract (generated code derives from it)
├── cmd/app/               # binary: serve, migrate, seed, bootstrap-admin
├── internal/              # one Go package per module + platform infrastructure
├── web/                   # React SPA
├── e2e/                   # Playwright specs (run against the built image, qa seed)
├── deploy/                # compose files, Caddyfile, postgres init, backup script
├── docs/                  # business docs, specs, task board, standards, runbook
└── .github/               # CI, build, templates, Dependabot
```

Folder purposes in depth: [docs/technical-specs/03-repository-structure.md](docs/technical-specs/03-repository-structure.md).

## Branches and pull requests

| Branch | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `dev` | Default branch; every card PR targets it |
| `test` | QA on the UAT environment; updated only by PR from `dev` |
| `main` | Production releases; updated only by PR from `test` |

Rules (convention until branch protection is available on the org plan): never push directly to `test` or `main`; one card per PR on branch `<card-id>-<slug>`; PR title `type(module): summary [CARD-ID]`; squash merge with green CI and one approving review.

## Documentation

| Document | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/ONBOARDING_GUIDE.md](docs/ONBOARDING_GUIDE.md) | New contributor path: setup to first change |
| [docs/DEVELOPMENT_SCENARIO_GUIDE.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT_SCENARIO_GUIDE.md) | How to do each recurring task end to end |
| [docs/GLOSSARY.md](docs/GLOSSARY.md) | Domain and engineering terms |
| [docs/business/](docs/business/) | User stories, acceptance criteria, sprint plan |
| [docs/technical-specs/](docs/technical-specs/_index.md) | Architecture, modules, data model, security, NFRs |
| [docs/api-specs/](docs/api-specs/_index.md) | REST contract and operation status tracker |
| [docs/TASK_BREAKDOWN.md](docs/TASK_BREAKDOWN.md) | Sprint task cards (mirrored as GitHub issues) |
| [docs/CODING_STANDARD.md](docs/CODING_STANDARD.md) | Coding rules |
| [docs/CODE_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md](docs/CODE_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md) | Per-PR review gate |
| [docs/DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md](docs/DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) | Deploy, release, rollback, reset, backups |
| [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) | Symptom-indexed fixes for UAT and prod |

Work is tracked on the [turtwig-ddcl delivery](https://github.com/orgs/aquascapedotorg/projects/4) board.

repos.readme:
# PixelOffice 🏢🕹️

> **A nostalgic 16-bit pixel-art virtual workspace** featuring real-time spatial character movement across three interactive floors, proximity chat, customizable avatars, retro audio, and collaborative office spaces.

[![React 19](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19.0-61dafb?logo=react&logoColor=black)](https://react.dev/)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-7.0-3178c6?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
[![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-8.3-646cff?logo=vite&logoColor=white)](https://vitejs.dev/)
[![Tailwind CSS v4](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind_CSS-v4.3-38bdf8?logo=tailwindcss&logoColor=white)](https://tailwindcss.com/)
[![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-Firestore-ffca28?logo=firebase&logoColor=black)](https://firebase.google.com/)
[![Google GenAI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google-GenAI_Gemini-4285f4?logo=google&logoColor=white)](https://ai.google.dev/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)

---

## 🌟 Overview

**PixelOffice** transforms remote and hybrid collaboration into an engaging 2D retro simulation. Walk around virtual office floors, run into teammates for spontaneous watercooler chats, grab coffee from the virtual espresso bar, brainstorm on shared sticky-note whiteboards, or take the elevator up to the rooftop Zen garden.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🏢 3-Floor Multi-Zone Virtual Campus
* **Floor 1 (Reception & Community)**:
  * Reception & Welcome Lobby
  * Kitchen, Café & Espresso Bar
  * Huddle Room
  * Open Collaborative Workspace
  * Breakout Lounge & Elevator Transit Bay
* **Floor 2 (Engineering & Operations)**:
  * DevOps & Server Lab (with animated server racks)
  * Engineering Open Pit
  * Deep Work Focus Pod
  * Sprint & War Room
  * Fuel Bar & Transit Core
* **Floor 3 (Executive & Wellness)**:
  * Executive Boardroom
  * Leadership Suite
  * Sky Lobby & Art Gallery
  * Rooftop Lounge & Zen Garden

### 🎨 16-Bit Pixel-Art Engine & Custom Avatars
* **Handcrafted Canvas Engine**: Smooth 60 FPS 2D tile-based rendering with custom procedural textures for wood floors, marble tiles, glass partitions, and office furniture.
* **Character Customizer**: Customize hair style, hair color, skin tone, shirt color, pants color, and accessories (e.g., headphones, retro glasses).
* **Directional Animations**: 4-way walking animations, sitting states, and idle breathing.

### 💬 Spatial Communication & Social Presence
* **Proximity Chat**: Messages appear as pixel speech bubbles over your avatar and in the spatial feed.
* **Private Direct Messaging**: 1-on-1 private messaging modals with real-time typing indicators.
* **Live Statuses**: Set your active status (`Working`, `In Meeting`, `Coffee Break`, `Deep Focus`, `Away`) with customizable status messages.
* **AI Bot Teammates**: Pre-populated teammates (Alex, Maya, Devon, Elena, Sam) that bring the virtual office to life.

### ☕ Interactive Office Furniture & Tools
* **Collaborative Whiteboard**: Open interactive whiteboard boards to leave retro sticky notes and architectural brainstorms.
* **Espresso Machine**: Brew coffee in the kitchen or fuel bars for a movement boost and retro chiptune sound effects.
* **Elevators & Portals**: Seamless elevator transitions between floors.

### 🎵 8-Bit Chiptune Audio
* Web Audio API synthesized retro sound effects: footsteps, elevator chimes, coffee brewing, whiteboard markers, chat pop-ups, and ambient background vibes (with a one-click mute toggle).

### 📱 Responsive & Touch-Ready
* On-screen retro D-pad and action buttons for tablets and mobile devices.
* Minimap with real-time floor awareness and colleague indicators.

---

## 🎮 Controls

| Action | Keyboard / Mouse | Mobile / Touch |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Move Up / Down / Left / Right** | `W`, `A`, `S`, `D` or `Arrow Keys` | Virtual D-Pad buttons |
| **Interact (Elevator, Coffee, Board)** | Walk near object + press `E` or `Space` | On-screen **Interact (E)** button |
| **Open Chat** | `Enter` or click the chat bar | Tap chat input bar |
| **Toggle Minimap** | Click minimap icon on top bar | Tap minimap icon |
| **Mute / Unmute Audio** | Click audio toggle in header | Tap audio icon in header |

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

* **Frontend Framework**: [React 19](https://react.dev/) + [React DOM](https://react.dev/)
* **Language**: [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) (Strict Mode)
* **Styling**: [Tailwind CSS v4](https://tailwindcss.com/) (`@tailwindcss/vite`) + [Framer Motion](https://motion.dev/)
* **Icons**: [Lucide React](https://lucide.dev/)
* **Engine**: HTML5 2D Canvas + Web Audio API synthesizer
* **Backend & Realtime**: [Firebase Firestore](https://firebase.google.com/docs/firestore) + Express server
* **AI Intelligence**: [Google GenAI SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@google/genai) (`@google/genai`)
* **Build Tool**: [Vite 8](https://vitejs.dev/)
* **Package Manager**: [Bun](https://bun.sh/) / [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/)

---

## 🚀 Quickstart

### Prerequisites
* **Node.js** (v18+) or **Bun** (v1.0+)

### 1. Clone & Install
```bash
git clone https://github.com/aquascapedotorg/rottom-hq.git
cd rottom-hq

# Install dependencies (using Bun or npm)
bun install
# or
npm install
```

### 2. Configure Environment Variables
Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local`:
```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
```

Set your credentials in `.env.local`:
```env
# Google Gemini API Key
GEMINI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key_here

# Firebase Configuration (Optional for offline demo mode)
VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_firebase_api_key
VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=your_project.firebaseapp.com
VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your_project_id
VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=your_project.appspot.com
VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_sender_id
VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_app_id
```

### 3. Start Development Server
```bash
npm run dev
# or
bun run dev
```

The app will be accessible at `http://localhost:3000`.

---

## 📦 Available Scripts

* **`npm run dev`**: Starts the Vite dev server with host binding (`--port=3000 --host=0.0.0.0`).
* **`npm run build`**: Compiles TypeScript and creates the production distribution in `dist/`.
* **`npm run preview`**: Previews the production build locally.
* **`npm run lint`**: Runs TypeScript type checking (`tsc --noEmit`).
* **`npm run clean`**: Cleans previous build artifacts (`dist/` and `server.js`).

---

## 📂 Project Structure

```
pixeloffice/
├── .agents/                 # ECC AI Agent rules, skills, and workflows
├── src/
│   ├── components/          # UI Modals, Header, Sidebar, ChatBar, Minimap
│   │   ├── AuthModal.tsx
│   │   ├── AvatarCustomizerModal.tsx
│   │   ├── ChatBar.tsx
│   │   ├── CoffeeModal.tsx
│   │   ├── Header.tsx
│   │   ├── Minimap.tsx
│   │   ├── MobileControls.tsx
│   │   ├── PrivateChatModal.tsx
│   │   ├── ProfileModal.tsx
│   │   ├── Sidebar.tsx
│   │   ├── StatusSelectorModal.tsx
│   │   └── WhiteboardModal.tsx
│   ├── context/             # Authentication & user state context
│   ├── game/                # 16-bit rendering engine, audio, maps & sprites
│   │   ├── audio.ts         # Retro Web Audio synthesizer
│   │   ├── engine.ts        # Canvas game loop, camera, collision & input
│   │   ├── sprites.ts       # Pixel-art generator for avatars & props
│   │   └── maps/            # Floor 1, Floor 2, Floor 3 tilemaps
│   ├── services/            # Real-time sync & simulated bot users
│   ├── types/               # TypeScript interfaces & types
│   ├── App.tsx              # Main application root
│   ├── main.tsx             # React DOM entrypoint
│   └── index.css            # Base styles and Tailwind imports
├── firestore.rules          # Cloud Firestore security rules
├── GIT_WORKFLOW.md          # Git branching & promotion workflow (dev > uat > main)
├── package.json             # Scripts & dependencies
├── tsconfig.json            # TypeScript configuration
├── vite.config.ts           # Vite configuration
└── CLAUDE.md                # Development instructions & guidelines
```

---

## 🌿 Git Branching Workflow

This project follows a 3-tier promotion lifecycle: **`Feature` ➔ `dev` ➔ `uat` ➔ `main`**.
For full details on branching rules, promotion PRs, and hotfixes, see [GIT_WORKFLOW.md](GIT_WORKFLOW.md).

---

## 📄 License

This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

repos.description: Deterministic, non-LLM test script generator. Business-rule DSL to Playwright, Cypress, Selenium & Robot Framework via 6-tier heuristic DOM matching.
repos.readme:
# Tester Lab: Non-LLM Automated Test Script Generator

![License: Proprietary](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Proprietary-red.svg)
![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node-20.19%2B-brightgreen.svg)
![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.x-3178C6.svg)

**Sistem Generator Script Testing Otomatis Berbasis Rule & Heuristic DOM Matching (Deterministik, Tanpa LLM)**

`tester-lab` adalah engine otomatisasi pengujian *end-to-end* yang menghasilkan script test secara otomatis berdasarkan file skenario aturan bisnis (**JSON / YAML DSL**), tanpa bergantung pada Large Language Model (LLM). Engine ini secara bawaan mendukung berbagai framework industri terkemuka: **Playwright (TypeScript & JavaScript), Cypress, Selenium (Python), dan Robot Framework**.

Selain generasi, Tester Lab juga mengimpor test yang sudah ada (spec Playwright, JSON, atau YAML) kembali menjadi langkah scenario, sehingga test lama dipakai ulang tanpa menyusun ulang dari nol. Impor proyek Katalon Studio direncanakan (US-35) dan belum tersedia.

---

## Mengapa Tanpa LLM?

1. **Deterministik & 100% Konsisten:** Hasil generasi script selalu identik untuk input bisnis yang sama. Tidak ada risiko halusinasi selector, kesalahan sintaks, atau perubahan perilaku acak.
2. **Kepatuhan Privasi & Keamanan Data (Zero Data Leakage):** Struktur DOM internal, atribut halaman, dan data rahasia tidak pernah dikirim ke API kecerdasan buatan pihak ketiga.
3. **Tanpa Latensi Inferensi:** Pencocokan heuristik berjalan lokal dalam hitungan milidetik. Waktu generasi total didominasi crawl browser ke situs target, yang bisa memakan puluhan detik, bukan oleh pencocokan.
4. **Biaya Operasional Nol (Zero Token/API Cost):** Tanpa langganan API berulang, tanpa kuota token bulanan.

---

## Fitur Utama

- **Deterministic 6-Tier Scoring Matrix:** Pencocokan label ke elemen DOM interaktif dengan bobot prioritas teruji (*Test ID -> Associated Label -> ARIA Role & Accessible Name -> InnerText -> Placeholder/Aria-Label -> Fuzzy Levenshtein*).
- **Multi-Framework Code Transpiler:** Transpilasi otomatis ke **Playwright (TS/JS)**, **Cypress**, **Selenium Python**, dan **Robot Framework** terformat rapi via Prettier AST. Output non-Playwright dijaga agar tidak dieksekusi langsung di server (hanya diunduh).
- **Katalon Project Import (.zip):** Direncanakan (US-35), belum tersedia.
- **File Import (.json / .yaml / spec):** Impor scenario dari file JSON, YAML, atau spec Playwright (`.spec.ts`/`.spec.js`) di Scenario Builder. Tipe file lain tidak diterima.
- **Dry-Run & Self-Healing Engine:** Validasi headless langsung pasca-generasi dengan kemampuan *auto-healing* ke kandidat Rank-2 jika selector pertama gagal.
- **Interaction Recorder (Point-and-Click DSL Capture):** Rekam interaksi langsung pada situs target yang dimuat melalui *reverse-proxy* ber-guard SSRF. Agen perekam yang diinjeksi menangkap aksi `click`/`fill` pengguna, menggabungkan langkah `fill` beruntun pada field yang sama, dan mengubahnya menjadi step DSL siap-generate — tanpa perlu menulis skenario manual.
- **Web Workspace & Interactive Admin Portal:** UI modern responsif dengan Scenario Builder, Interaction Recorder, Runs & laporan run dengan video playback, Feedback Reporting, API Key Management, dan Admin Control Center.
- **Enterprise-Grade Security:**
  - **API Key Masking & SHA-256 Hashing:** Penyimpanan hash kriptografis aman, raw key hanya ditampilkan sekali saat pembuatan, dan prefix di-mask (`tl_live_xxxx...yyyy`).
  - **Dual Authentication Middleware:** Mendukung JWT Bearer Token dan `X-API-Key` dengan Role-Based Access Control (Admin / User) & User Status Approval (`pending`, `approved`, `rejected`).
  - **AST/Regex Code Sanitizer:** Memblokir eksekusi kode berbahaya (`fs`, `child_process`, `eval`, `process.env`) sebelum dieksekusi — berlaku pada jalur `/run-test` maupun dry-run.
  - **SSRF Outbound Guard:** Setiap target *reverse-proxy* recorder divalidasi via `assertSafeProxyUrl()` yang menolak URL non-http(s), hostname internal, serta rentang IP privat/reserved (termasuk metadata cloud `169.254.169.254`), sebelum & sesudah redirect.
  - **Private Storage Buckets & Signed URL:** Bucket Supabase Storage (`test-evidence`, `test-videos`, `feedback-attachments`) bersifat *private*; aset hanya disajikan lewat *signed URL* berumur pendek yang di-*re-sign* saat dibaca — tidak ada URL publik yang dipersistkan.
  - **PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS):** Seluruh tabel database diamankan dan diisolasi dengan hak akses `TO service_role`.
- **Resource Concurrency Control:** In-memory queue manager untuk membatasi eksekusi paralel Playwright dan browser crawler guna mencegah *resource exhaustion*.
- **Flexible DSL Support:** Mendukung format file konfigurasi skenario **JSON** dan **YAML** dengan normalisasi otomatis.

---

## Arsitektur & Pipeline Sistem

Skenario DSL dapat ditulis manual (JSON/YAML) **atau** dihasilkan otomatis oleh
**Interaction Recorder** — pengguna merekam klik & isian pada situs target yang
dimuat lewat *reverse-proxy* ber-guard SSRF, dan aksinya dikonversi menjadi step
DSL. Setelah DSL terbentuk, pipeline deterministik berikut yang berjalan:

```
[ DSL Manual (JSON / YAML)  ─┐
[ Interaction Recorder ]  ───┴──► [ Business Rule DSL ]
               │
               ▼
    1. Zod DSL Validator & Normalizer (src/validator/dsl-validator.ts)
               │
               ▼
    2. State-Transition DOM Extractor (src/crawler/dom-extractor.ts)
       - Headless Playwright Chromium Crawler
       - Ekstraksi elemen interaktif, accessibility tree, & bounding box
               │
               ▼
    3. Heuristic Scoring & Matcher Engine (src/matcher/heuristic-matcher.ts)
       - 6 Deterministik Heuristic Rules
       - Tag suitability filtering & coordinate disambiguation
               │
               ▼
    4. Selector Strategy Resolver (src/matcher/selector-resolver.ts)
       - getByTestId, getByLabel, getByRole, getByPlaceholder, getByText, locator
               │
               ▼
    5. Multi-Framework Code Generator (src/generator/code-generator.ts)
       - Handlebars Templates (Playwright TS/JS, Cypress, Selenium Python, Robot)
       - Format kode otomatis via Prettier
               │
               ▼
    6. Dry-Run & Self-Healing Engine (src/validator/dry-run-engine.ts)
       - Headless test execution validation
       - Auto-healing fallback ke Rank 2 candidate jika selector bermasalah
               │
               ▼
 [ Output Artifact: File Script Testing (.spec.ts / .cy.js / .py / .robot) ]
```

---

## Matriks Skoring Heuristik

Pencocokan elemen dilakukan menggunakan matriks bobot deterministik untuk memilih *locator strategy* paling stabil:

| Prioritas | Kriteria / Rule | Skor | Strategi Locator | Deskripsi & Stabilitas |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Direct Test ID Match** | **100** | `page.getByTestId(...)` | Match exact `data-testid`, `data-test`, `id-test`. Paling kebal perubahan UI. |
| **2** | **Associated Label Match** | **85 – 90** | `page.getByLabel(...)` | Match `<label for="...">` atau wrapper label langsung. Standar aksesibilitas tinggi. |
| **3** | **ARIA Role & Name Match** | **75 – 88** | `page.getByRole(...)` | Match semantik ARIA role (`button`, `textbox`, `combobox`) + accessible name. |
| **4** | **Visual Text / Value Match** | **60 – 85** | `page.getByText(...)` | Match teks visual yang terlihat di layar (`innerText`). |
| **5** | **Placeholder / Aria-Label** | **65 – 80** | `page.getByPlaceholder(...)` | Match atribut `placeholder` atau `aria-label` pada elemen input. |
| **6** | **Fuzzy Levenshtein Match** | **30 – 50** | `page.locator('text=...')` | Toleransi perbedaan ejaan ringan / dynamic prefix. |

## Prasyarat & Instalasi

### Prasyarat
- **Node.js**: `v20.19+` atau `v22.12+` (build client Vite menolak versi lebih lama)
- **NPM**: `v9.x` atau `v10+`

### 1. Clone Repositori & Install Dependensi
```bash
git clone https://github.com/aquascapedotorg/rotomate.git
cd rotomate
npm install
npm install --prefix client
```

### 2. Install Browser Binary Playwright
```bash
npx playwright install chromium
```

### 3. Konfigurasi Environment (`.env`)
Salin template `.env.example` ke `.env`:
```bash
cp .env.example .env
```
Sesuaikan konfigurasi environment:
```env
PORT=3000
HOST=127.0.0.1

# Kredensial Supabase (PostgreSQL & Storage). Wajib; tidak ada default yang berfungsi.
SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project.supabase.co
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=your-service-role-key

# Buat dengan: openssl rand -base64 32. Jangan memakai nilai contoh.
JWT_SECRET=

# Kosongkan bila admin dibuat lewat npm run seed:dev atau seed:qa. Password yang pernah
# dipublikasikan di repositori ini ditolak saat boot.
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin
ADMIN_PASSWORD=

PLAYWRIGHT_TIMEOUT=120000
MAX_CONCURRENT_TESTS=3
MAX_CONCURRENT_GENERATIONS=5
```

Daftar lengkap variabel ada di `.env.example` dan [docs/DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md](docs/DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) §5.4. Periksa konfigurasi dengan `npm run preflight` sebelum menjalankan aplikasi.

### 4. Build Project
```bash
npm run build
```

## Penggunaan CLI (`test-gen`)

Tester Lab menyediakan CLI mandiri untuk generasi cepat dari terminal:

### 1. Generasi Script dari File JSON atau YAML
```bash
# Menggunakan file JSON
node dist/cli/index.js generate --config ./login-flow.json --out ./tests/login.spec.ts   # buat dari contoh di bagian Format DSL

# Menggunakan file YAML (contoh yang ada di repositori)
node dist/cli/index.js generate --config ./examples/google-form-survey.yaml --out ./tests/survey.spec.ts
```

### 2. Generasi dengan Verifikasi Otomatis (Dry-Run)
```bash
node dist/cli/index.js generate --config ./examples/google-form-survey.yaml --out ./tests/survey.spec.ts --dry-run
```

### 3. Inspeksi Elemen DOM dari Target URL
```bash
node dist/cli/index.js inspect --url https://example.com/login
```

## Format DSL Input

### Contoh JSON DSL (`login-flow.json`):
```json
{
  "testSuite": "Login Authentication Flow",
  "targetUrl": "https://example.com/login",
  "framework": "playwright",
  "language": "typescript",
  "steps": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "action": "fill",
      "targetLabel": "Email Address",
      "value": "user@example.com",
      "description": "Isi kolom email pengguna"
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "action": "fill",
      "targetLabel": "Password",
      "value": "SecurePass123!",
      "description": "Isi kata sandi"
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "action": "click",
      "targetLabel": "Sign In",
      "description": "Klik tombol sign in"
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "action": "assert_url",
      "expected": "/dashboard",
      "description": "Verifikasi URL beralih ke dashboard"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Contoh YAML DSL (`login-flow.yaml`):
```yaml
testSuite: Login Authentication Flow
targetUrl: https://example.com/login
framework: playwright
language: typescript
steps:
  - action: fill
    targetLabel: Email Address
    value: user@example.com
  - action: fill
    targetLabel: Password
    value: SecurePass123!
  - action: click
    targetLabel: Sign In
  - action: assert_url
    expected: /dashboard
```

## Menjalankan Backend Server & Web Portal

Jalankan server Express:
```bash
npm run start
```
Buka browser di `http://localhost:3000` untuk mengakses Web Workspace & Admin Console.

### Fitur Antarmuka Web:
- **Scenario Builder:** Pembuat skenario visual; import JSON/YAML atau spec Playwright; edit kode hasil generate secara inline; dan eksekusi generasi script satu klik.
- **Interaction Recorder:** Muat situs target di dalam workspace via *reverse-proxy* ber-guard SSRF, lalu rekam klik & isian pengguna menjadi step DSL otomatis.
- **Runs & Reports:** Riwayat run beserta laporan per story, kriteria, scenario, dan step, log eksekusi, serta pemutar rekaman video Playwright.
- **API Key Management:** Pembuatan dan pencabutan API key dengan ringkasan status hit (`generated`, `success`, `failed`).
- **Admin Control Panel:**
  - Persetujuan & penolakan pendaftaran pengguna (`pending`, `approved`, `rejected`).
  - Ringkasan aktivitas sistem & audit log.
  - Manajemen feedback dan unduhan lampiran pengguna.
  - Statistik agregat penggunaan API Key secara *real-time*.

## REST API Reference

| Endpoint | Method | Autentikasi | Deskripsi |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| `/api/v1/auth/register` | `POST` | Public | Mendaftarkan akun baru (status awal: `pending`). |
| `/api/v1/auth/login` | `POST` | Public | Login pengguna, mengembalikan JWT token. |
| `/api/v1/auth/me` | `GET` | JWT / API Key | Mengambil profil user yang sedang aktif. |
| `/api/v1/generate-script` | `POST` | JWT / API Key | Mengekstraksi DOM dan menghasilkan script testing. |
| `/api/v1/inspect-dom` | `POST` | JWT / API Key | Mengambil daftar elemen kandidat interaktif dari URL target. |
| `/api/v1/run-test` | `POST` | JWT / API Key | Mengeksekusi script Playwright dan mengunggah artifact video. |
| `/api/v1/api-keys` | `GET` | JWT Only | Mengambil daftar API Key pengguna beserta statistik hit. |
| `/api/v1/api-keys` | `POST` | JWT Only | Membuat API Key baru (mengembalikan raw key sekali saja). |
| `/api/v1/api-keys/:id` | `DELETE` | JWT Only | Mencabut (*revoke*) status aktif API Key. |
| `/api/v1/api-keys/:id/delete` | `DELETE` | JWT Only | Menghapus permanen record API Key. |
| `/api/v1/feedback` | `POST` | Public | Mengirim feedback dan lampiran file. |
| `/api/v1/config` | `GET` | JWT / API Key | Mengambil konfigurasi & sample scenario sistem. |
| `/api/v1/config` | `POST` | Admin Only | Memperbarui konfigurasi sistem. |
| `/api/v1/recorder/ingest` | `POST` | Public* | Ingestion step dari agen perekam (dijalankan di dalam halaman ter-proxy; validasi & rate-limit ketat). |
| `/api/v1/recorder/session/:sessionId/steps` | `GET` | JWT / API Key | Polling step yang tertangkap untuk sesi perekaman. |
| `/api/v1/recorder/session/:sessionId` | `DELETE` | JWT / API Key | Mengakhiri & membersihkan sesi perekaman. |
| `/api/v1/recorder/proxy` | `GET` | JWT / API Key | *Reverse-proxy* ber-guard SSRF untuk memuat situs target di dalam recorder. |
| `/api/v1/admin/users` | `GET` | Admin Only | Mengambil daftar seluruh pengguna dan status approval. |
| `/api/v1/admin/users/:id/approve` | `POST` | Admin Only | Menyetujui akun pendaftaran pengguna. |
| `/api/v1/admin/users/:id/reject` | `POST` | Admin Only | Menolak akun pendaftaran pengguna. |
| `/api/v1/admin/users/:id` | `DELETE` | Admin Only | Menghapus akun pengguna. |
| `/api/v1/admin/logs` | `GET` | Admin Only | Audit log aktivitas sistem (paginasi). |
| `/api/v1/admin/feedbacks` | `GET` | Admin Only | Daftar feedback pengguna beserta lampiran. |
| `/api/v1/admin/feedbacks/:id` | `DELETE` | Admin Only | Menghapus record feedback. |
| `/api/v1/admin/api-keys/stats` | `GET` | Admin Only | Statistik agregat request & hit seluruh API Key. |
| `/api/v1/admin/api-keys/logs` | `GET` | Admin Only | Log paginasi hit API Key di seluruh sistem. |

> \* `POST /recorder/ingest` sengaja tidak terautentikasi karena dipanggil dari dalam halaman pihak ketiga yang di-*proxy*. Endpoint ini divalidasi ketat (pola `sessionId`, batas ukuran field, batas step & sesi) dan hanya menulis ke buffer perekaman in-memory.

Tabel di atas memuat sebagian endpoint. Daftar lengkap, termasuk projects, suites, stories, scenarios, runs, dan reports, ada di [docs/api-specs/](docs/api-specs/_index.md).

## Struktur Direktori

```text
rotomate/
|-- AGENTS.md            # Aturan yang wajib dipatuhi kontributor dan agen AI
|-- CONTRIBUTING.md      # Alur branch, pull request, dan verifikasi
|-- client/              # Klien React (UI target), dibangun ke dist/public
|-- public/              # UI lama (vanilla JS), dipensiunkan per layar
|-- src/
|   |-- cli/             # CLI test-gen (generate, inspect)
|   |-- crawler/         # Ekstraksi elemen interaktif via Playwright
|   |-- matcher/         # Skoring heuristik dan resolusi selector
|   |-- generator/       # Render kode dari template
|   |-- templates/       # Template Handlebars per framework (lima)
|   |-- validator/       # Validasi DSL, dry-run, self-healing
|   |-- security/        # Code sanitizer, SSRF guard, env allowlist
|   |-- db/              # Runner migrasi dan seed; SQL ada di migrations/
|   |-- server/          # Aplikasi Express: routes, services, stores, ops, stubs
|   `-- types/           # Tipe domain dan kontrak API bersama
|-- tests/               # Unit test Vitest, mencerminkan src/
|-- scripts/             # Preflight, smoke, security checks, helper dokumentasi
|-- deploy/              # Contoh konfigurasi nginx untuk dev
|-- examples/            # Situs target demo dan contoh file DSL
`-- docs/                # Seluruh dokumentasi
```

Struktur ini dapat dibuat ulang dengan `python scripts/repo_tree.py . --max-depth 2`.
